name: Psychedelic Fillmore
description: Late-1960s San Francisco psychedelic concert poster: swirling liquid contours, vibrating orange-violet fields, hand-drawn optical ripples.
magic_media_keywords: Late-1960s San Francisco psychedelic concert poster, swirling liquid contour shapes and melting curvilinear frames, vibrating orange and violet color fields, hand-drawn optical ripple patterns, warm practical tungsten glow haze, flat poster ink finish, one hypnotic swirl center left open as negative space for typography — swirl density drops to zero within the reserved zone, a perfectly still eye at the heart of the motion.
palette_hint: Fillmore heat — hot orange (#F26419) and deep violet (#4B1D82) with acid yellow (#F7E733), anchored by near-black plum (#1B1026) for legible contrast
best_for: music-festival lineups, vinyl-album art, and counterculture event posters with liquid-light typography
